_readme: Document Collection uploads -> Zoho's two Documents Collection forms, picked by candidate_type: EXPERIENCED -> documents_collection ("Documents Collection"), FRESHER -> documents_collection_trainee ("Documents Collection - Trainee"). Used by push_documents() in backend/app/services/zoho_push.py (HR button "Publish Documents"). Every API name was re-read live from GET forms/<form>/components on 2026-11-13; where the HR-supplied sheet disagreed, the live name wins (see _sheet_corrections). Both forms share the same upload field names except where noted per form.
_generated_readme: Zoho upload field -> PDF the portal builds itself (cif_pdf / declaration_pdf / reference_pdf). Uploaded from memory, and only once that form is submitted; a PDF that is not ready yet is skipped and named in the result.
_files_readme: Zoho upload field -> local Document.field_key(s), in priority order: the first one the candidate actually uploaded is sent. Fallbacks: the CIF profile picture fills Passport_size_photo when no Document Collection photo exists; the BGV passport copy fills Passport_Copy likewise.

_sheet_corrections.PG_Consolidated_Marksheet: Sheet maps "PG - Consolidated Marksheet" to PG_Certificate. Both forms actually have a separate PG_Consolidated_Marksheet field, and PG_Certificate is the PG certificate.
_sheet_corrections.Previous_company_3_role_change_letter: Experienced sheet maps "Previous company 3 role change letter" to Previous_company_3_relieving_letter and omits the relieving letter row. Both fields exist separately on the live form.
_sheet_corrections.Th_marks_sheet_Diploma: Missing from the Trainee sheet, but the live Trainee form has it.
_sheet_corrections.Assessment: documents_collection spells it Assessment (as the Experienced sheet says); documents_collection_trainee spells it Assessement. Neither has a local source, so it is not mapped.

_no_local_source: HR-side documents the portal never collects, left for HR to upload in Zoho: Offer_details_approved_document, Offer_acceptance_document, L1/L2/L3_document, HR_document, Assessment/Assessement, Other_documents, LevelShift_Offer_letter, Resume, PreludeSys_Resume (Experienced only), Level_1/2/3_Interview, HR_Interview, pre_induction_id, Employee_Name (Trainee lookup), and the Name / DOB / Relationship fields.
